response.query: If well data are scarce, which contingency strategies (transfer learning from synthetics, physics‑informed priors, data augmentation) best support hybrid training?
response.answer: When well data are scarce, transfer learning from synthetics, physics-informed priors, and data augmentation best support hybrid training. These methods enhance model performance with limited real data.
